title: docs(agents): narrow the package-level test claim, root test reads at the file
body:
Fixes #7800

## What the sentence claimed, and why measurement says otherwise

The 「怎么跑测试」 section of root `AGENTS.md` asserted that the package-level form —
`pnpm --filter PKG test` and `turbo run test` — runs the repo-root config **and reaches
the same conclusion as CI**.

objectui#3240 moved **vitest's `root`**. It did **not** move `process.cwd()`. A test that
resolves a filesystem path from the cwd inside an assertion therefore reads a *different
tree* under the two forms, and reaches a different conclusion.

Measured on this branch's own tree rather than inherited from the card:

```
$ node -e 'console.log(process.cwd())'
/home/user/objectui-issue-7800

$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n exec node -e 'console.log(process.cwd())'
/home/user/objectui-issue-7800/packages/i18n
```

## The two falsifications this corrects

| Card | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| objectui#7791 (PR #7796, merged 2026-09-05T21:26Z) | `CapabilityMultiSelectField.specParity-6285.test.tsx` — repo root `7 passed (7)`, package-level `2 failed / 5 passed`. cwd was the only variable. |
| objectui#7799 (PR #7806, merged 2026-09-05T22:42Z) | A sweep of `packages/*/src` found 19 tests of the same kind: 13 genuinely defective (repaired one by one), 6 measured immune under both cwds. |

## What this PR changes

One file, `AGENTS.md`, +14 / -3. Two halves, exactly the ruled direction A:

1. **Narrowed** the claim to what is true today — the package-level form runs the *same
   root config*; that it does not entail the same conclusion is now stated, along with the
   mechanism (`process.cwd()` stays at the package directory).
2. **Added** the corrective writer-side rule as a final bullet in the same list: a test
   that reads the filesystem inside an assertion roots that read at **its own file**, via
   bare `import.meta.url`, never at `process.cwd()`.

The new bullet reuses the spelling PR #7796 landed and #7806 adopted — walk up from bare
`import.meta.url` — and explicitly warns against resolving a relative specifier against
`import.meta.url`, which Vite rewrites in this repo's test transform into an `@fs`
dev-server URL that makes `fileURLToPath` throw `ERR_INVALID_URL_SCHEME` under **both**
cwds. No third spelling is introduced.

It also records the thing a reader would otherwise assume wrong: **nothing gates this
today**. objectui#7799 closed 13 instances, not the class.

## Deliberately fenced off

- **Option B** — re-pointing the ~40 package `test` scripts at a repo-root cwd. Out of an
  agent seat's authority; two seats ruled that independently.
- **Option C** — the lint rule that would keep the corrected sentence true. Real and
  wanted, but a separate card, and the placement question is not settled inside this one.
  Confirmed absent on this base: `eslint-rules/` holds 10 rule files, none mentions
  `process.cwd`; `eslint.config.js` has 0 `cwd` hits.

## Checks run locally on `9701f77ef`

| Check | Result |
|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | exit 0 — `OK (scanned 7153 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)` |
| `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | exit 0 — `Links are valid across 17 scan roots.` |
| `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs` | exit 0 — `OK (5/5 root(s) resolved -- AGENTS.md: 1 file(s), 15 fence(s) …)` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 — `No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` | exit 0 — 132 cases pass |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test AGENTS.md` | exit 3 — `GOVERNED`, as expected for this diff |
| The three suites that read the real `AGENTS.md` from disk | `Test Files 3 passed (3)` · `Tests 179 passed (179)` |

Suites run: `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts`,
`scripts/__tests__/check-shell-escape-residue.test.ts`,
`scripts/__tests__/check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts`.

**Lint is NOT MEASURED here, and cannot be.** `npx eslint AGENTS.md --format json` returns
`File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied` — markdown is outside the
configured universe of `eslint.config.js` entirely. Since the only changed file is one
eslint does not read, this diff cannot move any eslint verdict on any file.

**Changeset:** the presence gate's own verdict is that none is owed (see the table). The
`Changeset Declaration` required context is the job that runs exactly that script.

## Governed surface — this PR waits for a human

`AGENTS.md` is a governed surface. This PR stays **draft**: it is not flipped ready, not
enqueued, has no auto-merge armed, and carries no seat approval. Review is requested from
the two authorised accounts and the human merge is the review record.

The one thing needed from the maintainer is **approval of the final wording** — the
judgement itself needed no ruling, because the sentence was falsified by measurement twice.
